Phosphate Fosfato. Description. Phosphate is an anion given as various potassium or sodium salts. Incompatibility. Phosphates are incompatible with calcium salts; the mixing of calcium and phosphate salts can lead to the formation of insoluble calcium-phosphate precipitates. Incom- patibility has also been reported with magnesium salts.
